description: Debug JavaScript and TypeScript with vscode-js-debug and Rust auto attach.
error.runtime: The JavaScript debug runtime is unavailable. Rebuild or reinstall Ash.
setting.autoAttach: Automatically attach to Node.js processes started in new Ash terminals. Recreate terminals after changing this setting.
setting.smartPattern: Paths excluded from smart auto attach (glob patterns).
configuration.title: JavaScript Debug
autoAttach.alwaysDetail: Attach to Node.js programs started in new terminals. Create a new terminal after changing modes.
autoAttach.smartDetail: Attach to scripts outside the configured exclusion patterns. Create a new terminal after changing modes.
autoAttach.onlyWithFlagDetail: Attach only to programs with Inspector enabled. Create a new terminal after changing modes.
autoAttach.disabledDetail: Turn off automatic attachment and hide its status bar entry.
autoAttach.temporaryDetail: Keep settings and existing debug sessions. Resume in the same terminal; changing auto attach settings or restarting the extension clears the pause.
autoAttach.tooltip: Select to change or temporarily disable auto attach. Create a new terminal after changing modes.
autoAttach.pausedTooltip: Auto attach is temporarily disabled; the configured mode is {0}. Select to re-enable it in the same terminal.
